connector.name: MCP Obsidian Cli
connector.registryDescription: Save chat notes from Claude Desktop to your vault - MCP on Obsidian CLI. Keep what matters.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-obsidian-cli. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the stonematt account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_VAULT
env.description: Target vault name. If unset or unknown, the server prompts the caller on first tool use, listing the vaults Obsidian knows about.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_CLI_PATH
env.description: Path to the obsidian-cli binary. Auto-discovered on macOS; set explicitly on Linux/Windows or if the binary is non-standard.
